issues.description: Average Modifier calculations in Section 5.5 Mineral Richness Summary table are incorrect. All six star colors show lower values than the actual weighted averages.
issues.suggestion: Recalculate: yellow=1.14 (not 1.05), green=1.11 (not 0.99), red=0.98 (not 0.87), blue=1.44 (not 1.31), white=1.31 (not 1.13), purple=1.79 (not 1.63)

issues.description: Section 3.4 Probability Summary table shows incorrect Colonizable/Hostile percentages for Blue and White stars.
issues.suggestion: Blue should be Colonizable=41% Hostile=59% (not 46%/54%). White should be Colonizable=33% Hostile=67% (not 35%/65%).

summary: Planet Generation Tables specification is comprehensive, well-structured, and implementation-ready. All 13 JSON blocks are valid and parseable. Probability tables correctly sum to 100%. Cumulative ranges are accurate and cover the full 1-100 range. The spec is fully consistent with galaxy/generation-algorithm.md (star colors, environment tables, mineral richness, size distribution all match). Pet-themed naming (Hermit Crab special case) aligns with LORE.md. Two minor accuracy issues found in summary tables that don't affect the core implementation data. The specification exceeds requirements with excellent coverage of edge cases, algorithms, and worked examples.
